source.book: A2 Key for Schools Trainer 1（扫描版）

parts.1:
LISTENING PART 1
Questions 1–5

1 What time does the nature programme start?
Dad: Are you going to watch the nature programme after dinner tonight, Catherine?
Catherine: Yes, I think it begins at seven thirty, doesn’t it, Dad?
Dad: Let me check … Oh, it’s on just after the six-thirty sports programme, so ten past seven actually. We can have dinner earlier than usual if you like.
Catherine: Great!

2 Who is Diana talking to on her mobile?
Boy: Mum, who’s Diana phoning? Is she calling Aunt Christine about borrowing her bike?
Mum: She’s asking her friend Sarah, you know, our neighbour’s daughter, about some maths homework. Have you done your homework?
Boy: I’m doing a project with David, remember? He’s coming a bit later so that we can work here.
Mum: Oh, yes. You did tell me about David.

3 Where will Henry put his mum’s watch?
Henry: Mum, is this your watch here next to the cooker?
Mum: Oh, yes! Thank you, Henry, I was looking for it a minute ago in the sitting room. I thought it was on the sofa.
Henry: Shall I leave it in the kitchen or put it in your bedroom?
Mum: On that little table next to my bed would be great.
Henry: OK.

4 Why is the girl tired?
Girl: I think I’ll go to bed early tonight.
Boy: Yeah, you look tired. Did you play tennis with Jane after school?
Girl: She played with someone else. I walked all the way home because the bus was late. It took an hour!
Boy: Wow! But can you help me tidy my bedroom?
Girl: Erm, sorry!

5 What will the weather be like on Sunday?
Boy 1: I’m going swimming in the lake on Sunday with my mum and dad. Do you want to come?
Boy 2: Isn’t it going to be cloudy on Sunday?
Boy 1: That doesn’t matter because it’ll be about 25 degrees. Mum checked the temperature.
Boy 2: Oh, OK then. I went swimming when it was raining on holiday. It was really funny!
parts.2:
PART 2
Questions 6–10

Emiri: Hi. I’m phoning about the football match that we’re going to. It’s on Saturday. But it isn’t in the City Stadium like the last football match we went to. This one’s in the Bridge Stadium. That’s B-R-I-D-G-E. You know, near the river!

Can you come to my house at half past two? Then we can go to the match together by bus. Bus number two-seven-four only goes every thirty minutes, so it’s better for us to get the three-nine-five, which is every ten minutes.

The tickets are usually ten pounds, but because my dad’s a member of the football club, we only pay four fifty each. That’s not bad, is it?

It’s going to be a bit cold, so don’t wear just a jacket – you’ll need a coat. I’m going to wear my red one because that’s our team’s colour!

Oh, and another thing, bring a snack because the cafés are expensive. You can get water there for free, so don’t bring water.

I think that’s everything. Bye!
parts.3:
PART 3
Questions 11–15

Hitomi: Hi, Freddie. I went to Hardin Castle on Saturday.
Freddie: Did you go with your family or was it a class trip, Hitomi?
Hitomi: My class visited a factory. I went with the family who live next door to us.
Freddie: But the weather wasn’t good on Saturday …
Hitomi: Yeah, it rained, but I didn’t mind. It wasn’t cold and windy like today. Today’s worse!
Freddie: I went to Hardin Castle last year. I saw the dining room … but I liked upstairs better, especially the Queen’s bathroom.
Hitomi: Me too! I thought the yellow bedroom was strange. Why did you go to the castle? Was it to take photos? I know that’s your hobby.
Freddie: To get some information about wild birds. And I saw my history teacher when I was there!
Hitomi: Did you talk to him?
Freddie: Yes. There are lots of interesting things to do at the castle. Next week, there’s a race. You have to run five kilometres. Then, next month, you can see some cars that are over fifty years old!
Hitomi: Do they do painting courses?
Freddie: The next one’s next summer!
parts.4:
PART 4
Questions 16–20

16 You will hear a girl talking about a video. Which part of the video didn’t she understand?
Millie: I liked that film about animals that live in the Amazon Forest. It started by showing the different places different animals like to live in, and all that bit was clear. The next bit was difficult though. I needed my mum to explain it to me! Then the last part was good and I didn’t have any problems understanding it.

17 You will hear two friends talking about a concert. What’s the boy’s opinion of the concert?
Jess: I didn’t like the school concert yesterday, mainly because the musicians hadn’t practised enough. They were really bad, I think.
Tom: Really? I think they played well, but I’ve never heard music like that before or seen some of those instruments before.
Jess: It must be interesting to play new stuff, I guess.
Tom: Exactly! Doing the same thing’s awful.

18 You will hear a boy talking to his dad about going to the city centre. Why are they going to the city centre?
Boy: When are we going to the city centre?
Dad: I just want to see the end of this football match. Then, we can go.
Boy: Shall I phone Mum now to say we’ll be at the café in the main square in 30 minutes?
Dad: Yes, please. And could you ask her to get today’s newspaper for me?
Boy: Sure.

19 You will hear a teacher talking to his class. What information is he giving his students?
Man: Listen, everyone. Because you still need some photos to add to your geography project, we’re allowed to go to the park today! I know you love working there, but you must still make sure you do your school work carefully. We’re coming back to the classroom at ten, so that we have time to put everything away.

20 You will hear a boy talking about his sister, Emma. Who has Emma married?
Boy: My sister Emma got married last week to a guy she met in Paris. And now she lives in an apartment above that restaurant called Marco’s in Green Street. She finished studying art and design last year and has just got a job drawing pictures for a book! Her husband travels a lot in his job, showing tourists round different cities.
parts.5:
PART 5
Questions 21–25

Angela: Uncle Edward, we’re moving into our new school next month. They’ve built it next to the old one.
Edward: Fantastic! There were some problems with your old one, weren’t there?
Angela: Yes, like, the hall was a long way from the rest of the school!
Edward: But what was wrong with the cafeteria?
Angela: Well, you could always hear the traffic in the street outside or the crowds of people waiting for the buses.
Edward: Oh, OK. And your library?
Angela: It wasn’t too small or anything like that, just … dirty and not warm enough!
Edward: But were the classrooms OK?
Angela: Yeah…, my class used the ones on the second floor, but they didn’t have the latest equipment.
Edward: That’s a pity. Was there a lift?
Angela: They were so slow, you could walk faster! I don’t know why we had them!
Edward: I went to the your school office once.
Angela: There wasn’t enough space for two desks and the bookshelves. But the secretary liked it and said the shelves were quite useful.
Edward: Oh.

explanations.p1q1: Catherine 以为节目七点半开始，爸爸查看后说自然节目排在六点半的体育节目之后，"it’s on just after the six-thirty sports programme, so ten past seven actually"，即实际七点十分开始，因此选择 B；七点半只是 Catherine 的猜测。
explanations.p1q2: 妈妈说 Diana "She’s asking her friend Sarah, you know, our neighbour’s daughter, about some maths homework"，即她在给邻居家的女儿、朋友 Sarah 打电话问数学作业；Aunt Christine（借自行车）只是儿子的猜测，David 是要来家里一起做项目的男孩，因此选择 C。
explanations.p1q3: Henry 在灶台旁发现妈妈的手表，妈妈说 "On that little table next to my bed would be great."，即放到她卧室床边的小桌上；客厅沙发只是妈妈之前以为放手表的地方，因此选择 A。
explanations.p1q4: 女孩解释 "I walked all the way home because the bus was late. It took an hour!"，累是因为公交晚点、走路回家花了一小时；网球是 Jane 和别人打的，帮忙整理卧室是男孩的请求并被她拒绝，因此选择 C。
explanations.p1q5: 男孩 2 问 "Isn’t it going to be cloudy on Sunday?"，男孩 1 答 "That doesn’t matter because it’ll be about 25 degrees."，说明周日确实是多云，只是气温约 25 度照样能游泳；下雨是男孩 2 度假时遇到的，因此选择 A。
explanations.p2q1: Emiri 说这次比赛不在 City Stadium，而 "This one’s in the Bridge Stadium. That’s B-R-I-D-G-E. You know, near the river!"，并逐字母拼出 Bridge（桥）一词，还提示场馆在河边，因此填 Bridge。
explanations.p2q2: 去球场可坐 274 路或 395 路公交，但 "Bus number two-seven-four only goes every thirty minutes, so it’s better for us to get the three-nine-five, which is every ten minutes."，274 路半小时一班被否定，更推荐每十分钟一班的 395 路，因此填 395。
explanations.p2q3: Emiri 说 "The tickets are usually ten pounds, but because my dad’s a member of the football club, we only pay four fifty each."，票价通常是 10 镑，因爸爸是足球俱乐部会员，每人只需付四镑五十，因此填 4.50。
explanations.p2q4: 天气转冷，Emiri 提醒 "It’s going to be a bit cold, so don’t wear just a jacket – you’ll need a coat."，只穿夹克不够、要穿外套，因此填 coat；jacket 是被否定的选项，红外套是 Emiri 自己要穿的。
explanations.p2q5: Emiri 说 "Oh, and another thing, bring a snack because the cafés are expensive."，馆内咖啡馆贵所以自带零食，因此填 snack；水不用带，因为 "You can get water there for free, so don’t bring water."。
explanations.p3q1: Hitomi 说 "My class visited a factory. I went with the family who live next door to us."，班级去了工厂，她是和住在隔壁的一家人去的城堡，即和邻居同去，因此选择 C。
explanations.p3q2: Hitomi 说 "Yeah, it rained, but I didn’t mind. It wasn’t cold and windy like today."，周六下了雨即 wet；又冷又刮风说的是今天，不是参观当天，因此选择 B。
explanations.p3q3: Freddie 说 "I saw the dining room … but I liked upstairs better, especially the Queen’s bathroom."，Hitomi 立刻回应 "Me too!"，两人最喜欢的都是女王浴室；餐厅只是参观过，黄色卧室让 Hitomi 觉得奇怪，因此选择 A。
explanations.p3q4: Hitomi 猜 Freddie 去拍照（那是他的爱好），Freddie 说明此行是 "To get some information about wild birds."，即了解野生鸟类；历史老师只是在城堡碰巧遇见的，因此选择 C。
explanations.p3q5: Freddie 介绍活动安排："Next week, there’s a race."、"Then, next month, you can see some cars that are over fifty years old!"，绘画课则是 "The next one’s next summer!"，下个月的活动是 50 多年车龄的老爷车展览，因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q1: Millie 说开头介绍动物栖息地的部分 "all that bit was clear"，接着 "The next bit was difficult though. I needed my mum to explain it to me!"，最后部分也能看懂，没看懂的是中间部分，因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q2: Jess 嫌乐手练习不足、表现糟糕，Tom 却说 "I think they played well, but I’ve never heard music like that before or seen some of those instruments before."，从没听过、见过这样的音乐和乐器，即他觉得音乐会很不寻常，因此选择 C。
explanations.p4q3: 爸爸要先看完足球赛再出发，男孩提议 "Shall I phone Mum now to say we’ll be at the café in the main square in 30 minutes?"，即去市中心和妈妈在大广场的咖啡馆碰面；报纸是让妈妈帮忙带的，球赛是在家看的，因此选择 A。
explanations.p4q4: 老师说 "Because you still need some photos to add to your geography project, we’re allowed to go to the park today!"，并交代十点回教室收拾东西，即今天到户外（公园）上课；地理项目不是新开的，课时也没有变长，因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q5: 男孩说姐姐的丈夫 "travels a lot in his job, showing tourists round different cities."，带游客游览不同城市即导游；画画是 Emma 自己的新工作，餐厅只是她公寓楼下的店面，因此选择 B。
explanations.p5q1: 关于 cafeteria，Angela 说 "you could always hear the traffic in the street outside or the crowds of people waiting for the buses."，在餐厅总能听到街上车流和等车人群的声音，问题是吵闹，对应 noisy（B）；拥挤并未提及，因此选择 B。
explanations.p5q2: 关于 library，Angela 说 "It wasn’t too small or anything like that, just … dirty and not warm enough!"，否定了 too small，问题是脏，对应 not clean（C）；不够暖和说明偏冷而非 too warm，因此选择 C。
explanations.p5q3: 关于 classrooms，Angela 说 "my class used the ones on the second floor, but they didn’t have the latest equipment."，没有最新设备即不够现代化，对应 not modern（D），Edward 也感叹 "That’s a pity."，因此选择 D。
explanations.p5q4: 关于 lift，Angela 说 "They were so slow, you could walk faster! I don’t know why we had them!"，慢得走路都比它快、不知道为什么要装，即没什么用，对应 not useful（E），因此选择 E。
explanations.p5q5: 关于 office，Angela 说 "There wasn’t enough space for two desks and the bookshelves."，两张办公桌和书架都放不下，问题是空间太小，对应 too small（G）；秘书喜欢书架说明东西并非没用，因此选择 G。

uncertain: p5: "Edward: I went to the your school office once." 一行按原书页面逐字抄录，其中 "the your" 疑为原书排印如此（或应为 "your school office"），未做改动。
